using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Redis;
using StackExchange.Redis;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A Redis implementation of <see cref="VectorStoreCollection{TKey, TRecord}"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TKey">The type of the key.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TRecord">The type of the record.</typeparam>
    public class RedisHashSetCollection<TKey, TRecord> : VectorStoreCollection<TKey, TRecord>, IVectorSearchable<TRecord>
        where TKey : notnull
        where TRecord : class
    {
        private readonly IDatabase _database;
        private readonly string _name;
        private readonly RedisHashSetCollectionOptions _options;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RedisHashSetCollection{TKey, TRecord}"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="database">The Redis database.</param>
        /// <param name="name">The name of the collection.</param>
        /// <param name="options">The options for the collection.</param>
        public RedisHashSetCollection(IDatabase database, string name, RedisHashSetCollectionOptions options)
        {
            _database = database;
            _name = name;
            _options = options;
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task AddAsync(TKey key, TRecord record, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            await _database.HashSetAddAsync(_name, key.ToString(), record, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task AddRangeAsync(IEnumerable<(TKey key, TRecord record)> records, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var hashEntries = records.Select(record => new HashEntry(record.key.ToString(), record.record));
            await _database.HashSetAddAsync(_name, hashEntries, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task<TRecord> GetAsync(TKey key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var value = await _database.HashGetAsync(_name, key.ToString(), cancellationToken);
            return value == null ? null : (TRecord)(object)value;
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task<IEnumerable<TRecord>> GetRangeAsync(IEnumerable<TKey> keys, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var values = await _database.HashGetAsync(_name, keys.Select(key => key.ToString()), cancellationToken);
            return values.Select(value => (TRecord)(object)value);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task RemoveAsync(TKey key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            await _database.HashDeleteAsync(_name, key.ToString(), cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task RemoveRangeAsync(IEnumerable<TKey> keys, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            await _database.HashDeleteAsync(_name, keys.Select(key => key.ToString()), cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task<long> CountAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await _database.HashLengthAsync(_name, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task<bool> ContainsKeyAsync(TKey key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await _database.HashExistsAsync(_name, key.ToString(), cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task<IEnumerable<TKey>> GetKeysAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var keys = await _database.HashKeysAsync(_name, cancellationToken);
            return keys.Select(key => (TKey)(object)key);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task<IEnumerable<TRecord>> GetAllRecordsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var values = await _database.HashValuesAsync(_name, cancellationToken);
            return values.Select(value => (TRecord)(object)value);
        }

        /// <inheritdoc />
        public override async Task<IVectorSearchResult<TRecord>> SearchAsync(VectorSearchQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            // Implement search logic here
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;
using StackExchange.Redis;

public class RedisServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddKeyedRedisHashSetCollection_WithClientProvider_ServiceCollectionIsUpdated()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var clientProvider = new Func<IServiceProvider, IDatabase>(sp => new Mock<IDatabase>().Object);

        // Act
        services.AddKeyedRedisHashSetCollection<string>(serviceKey: null, name: "test", clientProvider: clientProvider);

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var redisHashSetCollection = serviceProvider.GetService<RedisHashSetCollection<string, string>>();
        Assert.NotNull(redisHashSetCollection);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddKeyedRedisHashSetCollection_WithoutClientProvider_ServiceCollectionIsUpdated()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddStackExchangeRedisCache(options =>
        {
            options.InstanceName = "test";
            options.Configuration = "localhost";
        });

        // Act
        services.AddKeyedRedisHashSetCollection<string>(serviceKey: null, name: "test");

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var redisHashSetCollection = serviceProvider.GetService<RedisHashSetCollection<string, string>>();
        Assert.NotNull(redisHashSetCollection);
    }
}
